name: Noise Background
description: High-performance procedural grain noise background with CRT static, film dust, vignette, and scanlines.
summary: An ultra-optimized hardware-accelerated procedural canvas noise generator engineered for cinematic backgrounds and atmosphere. Features sub-pixel pattern tiling via 32-bit Uint32 buffer rendering, 3 distinct procedural grain algorithms (film grain, analog static, and film dust), edge vignette darkening, CRT scanline rasterization, and automatic viewport/container adaptation with IntersectionObserver and reduced-motion support.
highlights: Sub-pixel pattern tiling running on 32-bit Uint32Array memory buffers for near-zero CPU overhead
Three selectable noise algorithms: Film Grain, CRT Static, and Film Dust
Built-in cinematic radial vignette and retro CRT scanline raster layers
Seamless container adaptation supporting both fixed fullscreen and container-bounded layouts
Automatic battery-saving lifecycle management with IntersectionObserver and document.hidden pauses
Full accessibility with automatic prefers-reduced-motion detection and animation freezing
anatomy: <div> (Responsive Container: handles ResizeObserver and IntersectionObserver lifecycle)
<canvas> (2D Canvas Buffer: renders high-density tiled noise patterns without CPU overhead)
<div> (Cinematic Vignette: radial gradient edge darkening layer)
<div> (Scanline Overlay: repeating-linear-gradient CRT monitor raster lines)

physics.engine: 32-bit Uint32 Procedural Buffer + 2D Canvas Matrix Pattern Transform
physics.description: Direct memory buffer generation coupled with GPU hardware-accelerated 2D canvas pattern matrix translation and jitter.

accessibility.aria: No role or aria-hidden is set. Extra props are spread onto the root div, so pass aria-hidden="true" for purely decorative use without children.
accessibility.reducedMotion: Automatically stops animated pattern jitter and freezes grain texture when prefers-reduced-motion is active.

recommended: Cinematic dark mode hero backgrounds in developer platforms, dashboards, and landing pages
Subtle analogue film grain texture inside card surfaces, modals, and container boundaries
Terminal, retro, or synthesizer interfaces utilizing CRT static and scanlines
bestPractices: Use low patternAlpha values (10 - 25) for subtle, premium film grain that does not overpower foreground typography
Pair with dark container backgrounds for optimal contrast with film grain highlights
Enable scanlines or vignette for retro hardware and CRT aesthetics

props.name: patternSize
props.description: Dimensions (width and height in px) of the offscreen noise generator pattern buffer tile.

props.name: patternScaleX
props.description: Horizontal scaling factor applied to the noise grain texture.

props.name: patternScaleY
props.description: Vertical scaling factor applied to the noise grain texture.

props.name: patternRefreshInterval
props.description: Frame interval divider governing pattern shifts (e.g. 1 updates every single frame).

props.name: patternAlpha
props.description: Opacity alpha intensity of the grain noise particles (0 - 255).

props.name: mode
props.description: Noise rendering algorithm: film grain, CRT static, or film dust.

props.name: animated
props.description: Whether the noise texture continuously shifts and jitters over time.

props.name: fps
props.description: Target render frame rate throttle cap.

props.name: vignette
props.description: Enables cinematic radial gradient vignette darkening around canvas boundaries.

props.name: vignetteDarkness
props.description: Darkness multiplier factor for the radial vignette edge falloff.

props.name: scanlines
props.description: Enables retro CRT monitor horizontal scanline overlay.

props.name: scanlineDensity
props.description: Pixel pitch spacing between CRT scanline raster bands.

props.name: scanlineOpacity
props.description: Opacity intensity of the CRT scanline raster bands.

props.name: blendMode
props.description: CSS mix-blend-mode applied to the noise canvas element (e.g. 'overlay', 'soft-light').

props.name: fullScreen
props.description: Whether the noise container fixes to the entire viewport (100vw x 100vh).

props.name: className
props.description: Additional CSS classes passed to the outer wrapper container.

props.name: canvasClassName
props.description: Additional CSS classes passed directly to the underlying canvas element.

props.name: canvasRef
props.description: Ref to the internal canvas element.

props.name: children
props.description: Content rendered above the noise layer.
